deviations: No source unit tests ported directly — services/reporting's tests target a local AnswerProjection-backed data-access pattern that no longer exists (replaced by a live cross-module pull via ScoringService/AttemptService); used as behavioral reference only, every test written fresh against the new architecture.

AttemptPublishedEvent relocated from com.pte.notification.dto.event (Phase 09 placeholder, since reporting didn't exist yet) to com.pte.reporting.dto.event (Phase 10) — the publisher now owns the event type, matching the StudentEnrolledEvent/ViolationDetectedEvent precedent exactly (producer owns the type, consumer imports it), avoiding a reporting->notification dependency that would have been inconsistent with every other cross-module event in this migration.
